notes: Profile: ReturnSmith builds returns and RMA orchestration for mid-market retailers. Heavy chat volume post-purchase (order status, label creation, scheduling pick-ups).
Main ask: reduce live-agent load by 40% with chat agent that can call shipping tools (carrier API lookups, label creation) and surface structured actions.
Latency SLO: must meet p95 end-to-end generation + tool call handoff under 350ms for conversational flows; streaming responses preferred for perceived latency.
Traffic pattern: baseline 1k concurrent chat sessions, seasonal spikes up to 3x (Black Friday/Cyber week). Needs predictable burst capacity and clear overage pricing.
Model preference: open-model variants OK but want Redwood-curated model with verified streaming profiles; fallback policy needed (simpler model) if capacity constrained.
Security: require SSO (SAML), audit logging of calls, customer-managed KMS for keys, and EU data residency for EU merchants. SOC2 report required before procurement.
Procurement note: commercial team expects a 12-month dedicated commit if POC passes latency/cost targets. Looking for a firm pricing SKU for seasonal bursts.
Internal champion: VP Product (Nadia Kumar) cares most about latency and end-to-end UX. AE/SE lane: Samira + Daniel. CSM TBD post-commitment.
customer_quotes: If streaming gives users the 'typing' feel while still hitting p95 under 350ms, we're willing to move to a reserved plan.
'During peak windows we have a 2.5-3x traffic multiplier — we need pricing certainty, not painful overages.'
'Tool-calling must be reliable: label creation failures are the biggest customer friction.'
